en.headline: Eligible residents can register for Huanggang joint e-channels
en.dek: The Immigration Department said Hong Kong residents can enrol from Tuesday for the rebuilt crossing's cooperative-inspection lanes.
body: Eligible Hong Kong residents can register from Tuesday to use the cooperative-inspection e-channels at the rebuilt Huanggang port, the Immigration Department said.

The department said registration is open through the Hong Kong e-Channel mobile app. Users must already have completed enrolment for the mainland express channel before they can use the cooperative-inspection lanes.

Residents aged 18 or above have four ways to enrol. Besides the app, the other three can be completed at Huanggang itself: at the e-channel enrolment office, at the cooperative-inspection channels, and at self-service kiosks at the port.

Assistant Director of Immigration Wong Kei said parents can also register children aged 7 to 17 through the app by entering the child's Hong Kong identity card number. He asked the public to enrol in advance.

Mainland visitors aged 18 or above who qualify can register at the Huanggang e-channel office and at the cooperative-inspection channels, the department said. The rebuilt port is due to open later; the department did not give an opening date in the announcement.

zh.headline: 合資格居民即日起可登記皇崗合作查驗通道
zh.dek: 入境處表示，重建後的皇崗口岸稍後開通，合資格香港居民可由星期二起經香港e-道程式登記。
body: 入境處公布，為配合重建後的皇崗口岸稍後開通，合資格香港居民由星期二起，可透過「香港e-道」流動應用程式，登記使用皇崗口岸的「合作查驗」自助通道。
入境處說，使用合作查驗e-道前，必須先完成登記內地快捷通道。
合資格的18歲或以上香港居民有四種登記方式。除應用程式外，其餘三種可在皇崗口岸辦理，包括e-道登記處、「合作查驗」自助通道，以及口岸自助服務站。
入境處助理處長汪奇說，家長亦可經應用程式為7至17歲子女登記，過程中要輸入子女的香港身份證號碼。他呼籲市民預先登記。
合資格的18歲或以上內地訪客，則可到皇崗口岸e-道登記處及「合作查驗」自助通道登記。入境處今次公布未有交代口岸具體開通日期。
